Title: Updated Visual Studio tools for Apache Hive

Body.Content: Updated Visual Studio tools are available for Apache Hive. In addition to a complete tool package for Apache Storm, the tools for Apache Hive in Visual Studio include statement completion, local validation, and improved debugging support. For more information, please visit Get started using HDInsight Hadoop Tools for Visual Studio.
Body.Markdown:
Updated Visual Studio tools are available for Apache Hive. In addition to a complete tool package for Apache Storm, the tools for Apache Hive in Visual Studio include statement completion, local validation, and improved debugging support.

For more information, please visit Get started using HDInsight Hadoop Tools for Visual Studio .
